scope: Synthetic unrelated changed-schema transfer: 5 features × 4 zones × 2 phases; no biological or inferential claim
review_method: Opened the reference and candidate PNGs, then opened actual PDF and SVG renderings at 96 dpi (794×420 px). Inspected final physical proportions and separately checked actual exported PDF/PNG metadata. No implementation code/tests or prior review were read.
observations: Two 5-column by 4-row matrices use After then Before order; each summary bar/circle remains centered on the same feature column in both matrices.

Visible feature order is Feature#5, null, Feature 01, feature /3, ITEM-B. Visible region order is Zone / B, 001, Outer zone, NA. The specified whitespace-containing source IDs have only the declared display aliases; no category was visibly merged or dropped.
Feature#5 and feature /3 are orange; the outline spans null through feature /3 across the aligned layers.
The five middle bars include negative, zero and positive values; the supplied P classes show the three sizes of hollow circles on the zero line.

The readout and Agreement guides, P legend and axis labels are readable at the adopted dimensions; no clipped or crowded text was visible. The sparse feature set leaves unused white space, which is consistent with the fixed teaching geometry.

findings.location: SVG heatmap cell boundaries at 96 dpi
findings.evidence: The librsvg 96 dpi rendering shows faint cell-boundary seams; the matching PDF and PNG renderings do not show this grid. The seams do not alter cell colors, order or layer alignment.
findings.requirement: The two matrices should use the adopted filled-cell appearance consistently across exports.
findings.action: Prefer the inspected PDF/PNG for assembly. If SVG is the delivery format, check the intended application and suppress rasterization seams if they persist.

external_checks.check: Actual PDF typography and font embedding

evidence.embedding: pdffonts reports every ArialMT/Arial-ItalicMT subset embedded (Type 3).

evidence.interpretation: 2480×1311 pixels at approximately 300 dpi; integer-pixel dimensions agree with the declared 210×111 mm canvas within raster rounding.

external_checks.check: Source values, exact per-cell/per-bar numbers and upstream statistics
external_checks.evidence: This independent visual review did not read source tables, plotting code, tests, numeric QA or previous reviews. It validates visible mappings and actual exports; it does not recalculate normalization, cosine, ANOVA, P correction or dendrogram.

baseline_preference.reason: The main panel is an adopted reference-layer reproduction and the transfer is an unrelated fixed-layout example. No claimed refinement or aesthetic superiority over an accepted baseline was evaluated.

unresolved_items: SVG antialiasing seams depend on the receiving application.
Numerical/source correctness remains outside this independent image-only review.
